Title: Numb, cold, or swollen hands and feet by evening? 3 foods quietly hurting your circulation

Description:
If your hands and feet feel numb, cold, or swollen by the end of the day, it might not just be "getting older" - a few everyday foods could be part of the problem.

Deli meat, fried food, and sugary soda are three of the biggest everyday culprits behind poor circulation, and each one has an easy swap that doesn't mean giving up flavor.

Watch to find out why these foods slow your circulation, and what to reach for instead.
